review_candidates.description: ENODA’s world-class team is building the first truly decentralised, intelligent energy system that will reshape how we generate, store, and distribute energy. Foundational to our holistic and integrated platform approach, the Enoda PRIME® Exchanger is a first-of-a-kind dynamic power flow hardware designed to maintain “on-target” frequency and voltage, increasing grid efficiency and capacity for distributed energy sources like renewables and EVs. Enoda ENSEMBLE™ is our ecosystem co-ordinator of ENODA and third-party assets, able to forecast, aggregate, and bid capacity in real time, functioning as a networked “operating system” for the electrical grid. This is more than simply managing electricity flow. It is about creating the foundational system to prepare for a radically more capable, prosperous, and intelligent future. Job Description We have an opportunity for an experienced Digital Twin Engineer to join our Manufacturing team in support of our ongoing scale-up. As our Digital Twin subject matter expert, you will be at the forefront of our technological innovation journey as we develop scale up manufacturing environments. Your core focuses will be to create detailed virtual replicas of physical systems to enable predictive analytics modelling to drive continuous technological improvements. As such, you will integrate data from multiple sources which will require close collaboration with cross functional teams. This role will be responsible for developing and maintaining high-fidelity digital twins of manufacturing systems, enabling simulation, optimisation and validation of production processes before physical implementation. You will work at the intersection of Model-Based Systems Engineering, advanced simulation and Design Engineering to ensure efficient, scalable and high-performance factory designs. Design and build virtual models that accurately represent the behaviour and characteristics of a physical twin. This will involve developing the core simulation, physics, and mathematical models Develop and maintain digital twin models of gigafactory production systems, including equipment, material flow and facility layout Simulate manufacturing processes to validate throughput, capacity and performance targets Establish robust data pipelines to ensure a continuous, real-time flow of data from sensors, IoT devices, and enterprise systems (such as MES and ERP) to enable synchronization of the digital twin with its physical counterpart. Collaborate with process, mechanical, controls and facilities engineers to integrate design data into a unified digital environment Incorporate AI and machine learning algorithms to provide advanced analytics, optimize performance, and create predictive models in order to allow the digital twin to learn from data and adapt over time. Use digital twins to identify bottlenecks, optimise workflows and improve overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) Support virtual commissioning of production lines and automation systems Implement closed-loop feedback systems using real-time data to refine and update models Refine and scale the digital twin over time by incorporating new data layers and technologies. This will ensure that the model remains accurate and relevant as the physical system evolves Conduct scenario analysis for capacity planning, line balancing and future expansion Drive standardisation of digital twin methodologies, tools and data structures across the organisation Develop dashboards and user interfaces that make the complex data and insights of the digital twin accessible and actionable for engineers, managers, and other stakeholders Support integration with MES, SCADA and other manufacturing systems Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing and production operations Qualifications Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Manufacturing, Systems, or related discipline) Experience in digital twin development within manufacturing or industrial environments Strong understanding of manufacturing systems, automation and production processes Experience with simulation tools (e.g. discrete event simulation, process modelling, 3D factory simulation) Experience with sensor data collection and industrial communication standards. Experience with real-time operating systems and embedded programming. 3D CAD modelling using Solidworks or similar. Familiarity with MBSE principles and systems modelling approaches Knowledge of data integration, industrial IoT and real-time data systems Experience working on large-scale industrial projects (e.g. automotive, battery, or high-volume manufacturing) Strong analytical and problem-solving skills The Following Would Be Advantageous Experience with gigafactory or battery manufacturing environments Knowledge of robotics, PLCs and industrial control systems Familiarity with industrial protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, CAN bus) Experience with tools such as Siemens Tecnomatix, Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE, or similar platforms Understanding of layout optimisation, ergonomics and material handling systems Proficiency in languages such as Python, C++, C#, Java and MATLAB. Experience with cloud-based data platforms and digital thread architectures Additional Information Salary circa: £65,000 - £70,000+ (dependent on skills & experience) Private Medical Insurance Dental Cash Back Plan Income Protection Insurance Life Assurance Enhanced Global Family Leave Salary Sacrifice Bespoke Pension Scheme Employee Assistance Programme Work From Anywhere Policy Holiday Plus Scheme Cycle To Work Scheme Season Ticket Loan Interview Process Introductory video call with Talent Acquisition 2nd stage interview with Hiring Panel & Ambassador (Virtual) Final stage interview with Hiring Panel (In-Person or Virtual)

review_candidates.title: Consulting Associate, Healthcare Financial Planning & Analysis
review_candidates.description: Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes. Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. When healthcare organizations are managing escalating financial stress, Huron recognizes that the response must be urgent and direct. Huron’s industry-leading Healthcare Financial Advisory Services team works with healthcare leaders to strengthen financial management and prioritize business decisions that improve the financial trajectory of their organizations. Huron Assists Clients Through Improved Planning And Operations And During Periods Of Financial And Operational Change. Solutions Are Tailored To a Variety Of Situations, Including Business and financial planning, projections, and scenario analyses Budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning Decision support, cost accounting, and service-line analytics FP&A support and profit improvement Interim management and strategy execution Business assessments and due diligence Restructuring and turnaround Executive and Board advisory CFO support solutions Liquidity forecasting and management Working capital management Valuations We are seeking a Consulting Associate, Financial Planning & Analysis to join Huron’s Healthcare Financial Advisory Services practice. In this role, you will help hospitals and health systems strengthen the financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, performance reporting, and analytical capabilities that support informed decision-making. You will often work directly with CFO organizations, finance leadership teams, and operational stakeholders. You will work across the financial planning and performance-management cycle, helping clients establish financial expectations, monitor results, understand performance drivers, and determine where management action may be needed. Depending on the engagement, you may support annual operating budgets, rolling forecasts, long-range financial plans, labor and compensation models, capital budgets, monthly performance reporting, KPI development, scenario modeling, and other strategic or operational analyses. Your work will involve translating operational assumptions, including patient volumes, staffing levels, compensation, reimbursement, revenue, and departmental expenses, into integrated financial plans and forecasts. You will also combine financial and operational information to evaluate actual performance, identify the underlying drivers of revenue, labor, operating expense, and margin results, and assess the potential implications for future performance. Working alongside Huron project and relationship leaders and client finance and operational leaders, you will collect and validate assumptions, develop financial models, perform budget-to-actual and forecast-to-actual analyses, and translate complex findings into clear, decision-ready insights. Engagements may also include implementing or improving enterprise planning processes, management reporting tools, and performance-management platforms. You will also contribute to reusable financial models, planning methodologies, reporting tools, and engagement approaches that strengthen Huron’s broader healthcare financial planning and analysis capabilities. Candidates do not need equal depth across every area. We encourage applicants with strong experience in budgeting and forecasting, performance analysis and reporting, or a combination of these capabilities to apply . Qualifications 3+ years of relevant experience in healthcare finance consulting, hospital or health system finance, healthcare provider FP&A, budgeting and forecasting, decision support, accounting, transaction or advisory services, or a related analytical role Experience supporting hospitals, health systems, or other healthcare provider organizations, either internally or through consulting engagements Experience in one or more of the following areas: Operating budgets, rolling forecasts, or long-range financial planning Financial and operational performance analysis, management reporting, or KPI development Labor, staffing, compensation, revenue, volume, expense, or capital planning Scenario modeling, financial forecasting, or decision support Experience with healthcare-specific financial and operational measures, such as net patient revenue, patient volumes, payer mix, labor productivity, service-line performance, contribution margin, or capital planning, strongly preferred Demonstrated ability to perform budget-to-actual, forecast-to-actual, or other financial and operational variance analyses; identify performance drivers; and translate findings into actionable business insights Working knowledge of healthcare finance, including financial statements and the relationships among patient volumes, reimbursement, revenue, labor, operating expenses, and overall financial performance Experience working with finance and operational stakeholders to collect and validate assumptions, develop financial projections, communicate findings, and support decision-making Strong financial modeling and analytical capabilities, including advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and experience creating management reports, presentations, and other client-ready deliverables Experience with StrataJazz, Workday Adaptive Planning, Oracle EPM/Hyperion, Anaplan, Power BI, or a comparable financial planning, performance-management, or reporting platform, strongly preferred Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field; CPA, MBA, or another relevant advanced degree or professional credential preferred Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities and connect detailed financial analysis to broader business implications in a fast-paced consulting environment Travel and Home Location Travel requirements vary by project; candidates must be willing to travel up to 80% on a weekly basis Candidates may reside anywhere in the contiguous United States near a major airport The estimated base salary range for this job is $120,000 - $165,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $138,000 - $189,750. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future. Position Level Associate Country United States of America

review_candidates.description: Apply Job Type Full-time Description New Horizons is the largest mental health and addiction recovery provider on the Treasure Coast (and beyond), serving 15,000 children and adults annually through inpatient crisis services, 24-hour help line and mobile response team, and outpatient programs conveniently located across Indian River, Martin, Okeechobee and St. Lucie counties. New Horizons is a nonprofit agency seeking a caring and compassionate Care Coordinator who is eager to teach, want meaningful work that offers opportunities for growth, and believe that their efforts can make a difference in the lives of the people we serve. Now under new management, New Horizons offers competitive pay, amazing benefits, and comprehensive training. As a Care Coordinator Your Responsibilities Will Include Provides time-limited care coordination for 15 identified individuals between the ages of 5-21 using a combination of internal and external referrals and SEFBHN high-utilizer recommendations. Serves as a single point of accountability for the coordination of care with all involved parties (i.e., criminal or juvenile justice, child welfare, primary care, behavioral health care, housing etc.). Responsible for the coordination of services until the individual is adequately connected to the care that meets their needs and progress towards the goals of Care Coordination are achieved. Ensures individuals are engaged in their current setting (e.g., crisis stabilization unit (CSU), Residential Treatment Facility, Respite care, homeless shelter, addiction receiving facility, etc.) to establish a warm hand-off. Ensures frequent contact is maintained with identified individuals, ranging from daily to a minimum of three times per week, for at least the first 30 days of services, for those individuals who agree to receive care coordination services. If the individual refuses care coordination services or they are not responding to the attempts made, the Care Manager ensures the engagement attempts are recorded in the individual’s clinical record. Ensures that an internal process is in place that allows for on call services to be available 24 hours, seven days a week. Promotes the use of a standardized level of care tools and assessments to identify service needs and choice of the individual served in Care Coordination. Family and person centered, individualized, strength base plans of care utilizing the wraparound process to respect family voice and choice. The care coordinator provides options and choices such that the care plan reflects the individual’s values, strengths, needs and preferences. Promotes a recovery-oriented perspective that the individuals served, and their family members are the driver of goals on the Care Plan. SEFBHN system-level and provider Care Coordinators enter information into a?Care Coordination Module, an electronic platform, which encourages communication and education by sharing resources and information with others involved in an individual’s care. Takes a leadership role in assessing internal organizational culture and finds ways to incorporate the core values and competencies of Care Coordination into daily practice. Tracks unmet service needs and gaps and provides feedback to SEFBHN. Monitors access to psychiatric and therapeutic services to ensure that individuals who require medications and therapy are linked to services within seven days of discharge from higher levels of care. If no appointments are available, this is documented in the medical record and SEFBHN is notified. If the individual refuses services, this is documented in the record. Coordinate across systems, to include but not limited to physical health, behavioral health, social services, housing, education and employment and any other services and support that impact the social determinants of health. Monitors how effectively internal staff has incorporated into treatment plans the values, preferences, beliefs, culture, and identity of the individual served, and their community when providing care coordination. Ensures there are internal protocols for meeting the linguistic needs of the individuals served. Recommends ways that internal quality assurance protocols can address cultural and linguistic competence. The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change the duties at any time. Requirements New Horizons will need you to have the following qualifications: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college with a major in counseling, social work, psychology , and five years of full time experience working children at risk. Must pass Level 2 Background through DCF and AHCA Clearinghouse. For more information, click on the link: https://info.flclearinghouse.com Valid and current Florida Driver's License required with no more than 6 points in the past 5 years. Preferred Master’s degree from an accredited university or college with a major in counseling, social work, psychology, or a related human services field, and two years of full-time experience working children at risk preferred

review_candidates.description: Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Position: Chief Financial Officer Department: Finance Reports To: Chief Executive Officer Location: United States | Remote / Hybrid Position Summary We are seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the company's financial strategy, oversee financial operations, and support long-term business growth. This executive will be responsible for financial planning, budgeting, risk management, financial reporting, and capital allocation while ensuring strong financial controls and alignment with corporate objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Strategy & Leadership Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with the company's business objectives. Advise the CEO and executive leadership on financial performance and strategic decisions. Lead the finance and accounting departments. Establish financial policies, procedures, and performance standards. 2. Financial Planning & Analysis Oversee annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning. Analyze financial performance and identify opportunities to improve profitability. Monitor cash flow, operating expenses, and financial resources. Provide financial insights and recommendations to support business decisions. 3. Accounting & Financial Reporting Oversee financial statements, accounting operations, and reporting processes. Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of financial reports. Maintain appropriate internal controls and accounting standards. Coordinate external audits and work with accounting and advisory partners. 4. Risk Management & Compliance Identify and manage financial, operational, and regulatory risks. Establish effective internal control systems and financial governance practices. Ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and reporting requirements. Oversee tax planning, treasury management, and financial risk assessments. 5. Capital & Business Performance Management Manage capital allocation, liquidity planning, and investment decisions. Evaluate strategic investments, business opportunities, and financial partnerships. Support mergers, acquisitions, and corporate development initiatives when applicable. Establish KPIs and monitor financial performance across business units. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration; an MBA or advanced degree is preferred. 10+ years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, or financial management. Significant experience in senior financial leadership or executive roles. Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting. Experience with financial controls, risk management, and regulatory compliance. Excellent leadership, analytical, communication, and strategic decision-making skills. Preferred Skills Experience in financial services, fintech, investment management, or related industries. CPA, CFA, or other relevant professional certification is preferred. Experience managing finance teams and complex financial operations. Strong understanding of corporate finance, capital markets, and financial systems. Ability to translate financial data into actionable business strategies. Compensation Competitive executive-level compensation package, including base salary and performance-based incentives, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

review_candidates.title: Chargé(e) de développement commercial, partenariats & événementiel
review_candidates.description: NETINFO recherche un(e) Chargé(e) de développement commercial, partenariats & événementiel , capable de contribuer activement au développement de ses activités. Nous recherchons une personne dynamique, organisée et proactive, qui ne se contente pas d'exécuter des tâches, mais qui sait identifier les opportunités, prendre des initiatives et mener ses missions de manière autonome. Vous aimez développer des relations professionnelles, identifier de nouveaux clients, construire des partenariats et piloter des projets ? Ce poste vous permettra d'intervenir sur plusieurs dimensions du développement de l'activité. Informations sur le poste Lieu : Nabeul, Tunisie Mode de travail : Présentiel à 100 % Type de contrat : Temps plein Disponibilité : Immédiate Vos missions 1. Développement commercial et prospection Identifier de nouveaux marchés, clients et opportunités commerciales. Effectuer des recherches pour identifier les entreprises, institutions et organisations susceptibles d'être intéressées par les offres et services de l'établissement. Analyser les besoins des prospects et identifier les opportunités de collaboration. Constituer et développer une base de données de prospects qualifiés. Mener des actions de prospection par téléphone, email, LinkedIn et autres canaux pertinents. Présenter les offres et services aux prospects et assurer les premiers échanges commerciaux. Assurer le suivi des contacts, des relances et des opportunités jusqu'à leur concrétisation. Proposer des actions pour développer le portefeuille clients. 2. Développement des partenariats Identifier des partenaires potentiels et des opportunités de collaboration. Développer et entretenir des relations avec les entreprises, institutions et acteurs de l'écosystème. Identifier des opportunités de sponsoring et de collaboration. Préparer les propositions de partenariat et assurer leur suivi. Représenter l'établissement lors de rencontres professionnelles et événements. 3. Organisation et gestion événementielle Proposer des idées et concepts d'événements en cohérence avec les objectifs de développement de l'établissement. Organiser et piloter les événements de A à Z : workshops, conférences, rencontres professionnelles, journées portes ouvertes et autres initiatives. Élaborer les plans d'action, les calendriers et les budgets. Coordonner les intervenants, participants, partenaires et prestataires. Assurer le suivi logistique et opérationnel des événements. Superviser leur déroulement sur le terrain et gérer les imprévus. Assurer le suivi des contacts et opportunités générés par les événements. 4. Initiative et coordination opérationnelle Identifier les besoins et les opportunités d'amélioration. Proposer spontanément des actions et initiatives pertinentes. Assurer le suivi des projets et des tâches confiés. Gérer plusieurs missions en parallèle et organiser efficacement ses priorités. Produire des comptes rendus et suivre les résultats des actions menées. Profil recherché Nous recherchons avant tout une personne autonome, polyvalente et orientée résultats. Formation et expérience : Formation en commerce, marketing, gestion, communication, management ou domaine équivalent. Une première expérience professionnelle de 1 à 3 ans en développement commercial, prospection, gestion de projets, partenariats ou événementiel. Une expérience combinant plusieurs de ces domaines constitue un avantage. Compétences et qualités : Bonnes capacités de recherche, d'analyse et d'identification des opportunités. Aisance dans la prospection commerciale et la prise de contact. Excellentes capacités de communication et de négociation. Sens de l'organisation et capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément. Esprit d'initiative et orientation solutions. Capacité à apprendre rapidement et à travailler de manière autonome. Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et aisance avec les outils numériques. Bon niveau de français. L'anglais constitue un atout. Ce que nous attendons Nous recherchons une personne qui prend réellement possession de ses missions. Une personne capable de comprendre un objectif, de définir les étapes nécessaires et de passer à l'action sans attendre des instructions à chaque étape. L'autonomie, la proactivité et la capacité à transformer les idées en actions concrètes sont essentielles pour réussir dans ce poste. Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement initial pour comprendre les activités, les offres et les objectifs de l'établissement. Nous attendons ensuite une réelle capacité à prendre des initiatives, à proposer des solutions et à assurer le suivi de vos missions avec sérieux. La présence physique à temps plein dans les locaux de NETINFO à Nabeul est obligatoire. Pour postuler Merci d'envoyer votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes présentant vos expériences en développement commercial, prospection, partenariats ou organisation événementielle, ainsi que des exemples concrets de projets ou d'actions que vous avez menés.

review_candidates.title: Cardiothoracic Surgery Physician Associate
review_candidates.description: Summary Cardiothoracic Surgery PA role with Samaritan Health Services Samaritan Health Services, a non-profit integrated health care delivery system, is seeking an experienced Physician Assistant with an interest and background in Surgical specialties to join our Cardiac Surgery team in the picturesque and friendly community of Corvallis, Oregon. Job Specifics Established CT Surgery program for over 25 years, 3 APCs, and 2 surgeons to support you Great work/life balance within fun and enriching PNW community of Corvallis, OR Full scope practice with a combination of inpatient care, OR and minimal clinic with approx. 200 open hearts/year Duties include perioperative care of Cardiothoracic patients (ICU, Stepdown), surgical 1st assist with venous and arterial conduit harvest and shared call Competitive salary, starting bonus, relocation, CME, full benefits and more Position Requirements Must have surgical experience, cardiac surgery experience preferred BCLS and CPR Certifications required Should possess excellent clinical skills, communication skills, and a strong commitment to providing excellent care that is team-oriented. Eligibility to work in the United States In addition to financial incentives described above, we offer a market-aligned base salary, paid malpractice, a competitive benefit package, and use of EPIC EMR. For more information about this opportunity, please contact Samaritan Recruiter Austin Guzzon at aguzzon@samhealth.org. Additional Information Location Details: Good Samaritan Regional Medical Center is one of five Level II trauma centers in Oregon. It is the largest hospital in Benton, Lincoln and Linn counties with 188 beds. It offers dozens of medical specialties, including comprehensive cancer care, a full-service cardiology and cardiovascular surgery program, neurosurgery, orthopedic and spine surgery, inpatient mental health and other regional services. Good Samaritan Regional Medical Center is located in Corvallis, Oregon, a diverse and thriving college town that is home to more than 55,000 residents. Nestled in the heart of the Willamette Valley, Corvallis is an ideal location to work, live and raise a family. Within easy driving distance of mountains, rivers and the famed Oregon Coast, opportunities abound for outdoor enthusiasts such as camping, hiking, mountain biking, kayaking and skiing. As an added bonus, Oregon’s two largest cities and cultural centers — Portland and Eugene — are close by. About Samaritan Samaritan Health Services is a nonprofit regional health system serving communities across Benton, Lincoln, Linn and parts of neighboring counties. Since 1997, Samaritan has grown to more than 5,000 employees caring for over 290,000 residents. In fall 2026, Samaritan became the first health system in Oregon to affiliate with MultiCare Health System, a large nonprofit network based in Tacoma, Washington, expanding access to care and resources across the Pacific Northwest. Guided by a mission to partner for healing and a healthy future, Samaritan includes five hospitals, nearly 100 primary care and specialty clinics, retail pharmacies and fitness centers throughout Oregon’s mid-Willamette Valley and Central Coast. The organization also offers group plans and a Dual-Eligible Special Needs plan through Samaritan Health Plans and administers a Medicaid plan through InterCommunity Health Network Coordinated Care Organization.
